snippet.title: Ski Lines: Trail Map Official Trailer 1.1
snippet.description:
⛷️ *Wishlist Ski Lines on Steam & play the free demo!*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4854120/

*Your goal is simple: keep skiers moving.*

Ski Lines: Trail Map is a minimalist strategy game where you design and manage your own ski resort, one line at a time.

Draw ski slopes, build lifts, connect mountain landmarks, and watch hundreds of tiny skiers navigate your growing network. But as each day brings new challenges, keeping everyone moving becomes increasingly tricky!

🏔️ *Build your mountain*
- Draw green, blue, red, and black ski runs.
- Build and upgrade ski lifts.
- Connect summits, restaurants, viewpoints, and more.
- Expand your skiable area with snow cannons.
- Manage limited resources and avoid bottlenecks.
- Adapt to new challenges with roguelike progression.
- Explore iconic ski destinations around the world.

Whether you're looking for a relaxing mountain-building experience or a challenging optimization puzzle, there's always another route to discover.

🎮 *Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4854120/

🌐 *Official website:*
https://yunogames.studio/

Developed by Yunogames, an independent solo developer studio.

#SkiLines #IndieGame #StrategyGame
